features: Bot menu flow to add or remove one channel inside a selected pair
Mini App per-pair single-channel add form and per-channel remove controls
Shared Bot API domain service for both interfaces
Telegram admin/Post Messages permission check on add
Per-user channel limit and duplicate prevention
Soft removal and reactivation without duplicate PairChannel rows
Automatic pause below two active channels and safe auto-resume
Unit tests for add/remove and pause behavior
